gap_definitions.meaning: No reviewed semantic handoff is connected to an actuator or machine-protection authority.
Clock identity or a validated transform between source, facility, shot, simulation, review, and hardware clocks is incomplete.
The surface lacks captured physical evidence with immutable custody sufficient for the claimed meaning.
A shot or sample exists, but a resolved event identity or repeatable event reference does not.
A legacy normalized-angle adapter remains public but is not valid reactor-semantic ingress.
Physical mode identity lacks a validated harmonic basis, observation operator, reference, or observability threshold.
Calibration lineage, observation operator, uncertainty, quality, validity, geometry, or provenance is incomplete for observation admission.
No producer-owned implementation or evidence boundary exists in the four-project scope for one or more reactor families.

No producer plant-truth contract distinguishes UNKNOWN, out-of-distribution, low-observability, and stale states; software hold, abort, missing-data, or model states must not be promoted into that absent regime vocabulary.

payload.inclusion_rule: One row represents one externally meaningful public or cross-project phase, mode, regime, event, clock, or semantic-boundary symbol group. Duplicate internal calls and language mirrors are grouped under that stable boundary.

prior_atlas_deltas.change: The former no-U0-MIF-producer-handoff statement is obsolete: MIF-001 and SPO-007 now form an exact producer-to-SPO boundary.
The former open-text mode and unstandardized-axis statements are partially obsolete because SPO-003 through SPO-005 now provide registries, ontology, and eight-axis assessment contracts.
FUS-009, FUS-010, and SPO-009 add exact FAIR-MAST physical-source custody; they intentionally do not close phase-observability prerequisites.
CTRL-003 adds exact regime-assessment admission while preserving abstention, review-only authority, and no action path.

MIF-008 through MIF-011 add exact trigger-clock, protocol-state, diagnostic-calibration, and uncertainty-model boundaries; they expose STATE-01 rather than inventing plant-truth UNKNOWN, OOD, low-observability, or stale states.

payload.raw_scan_note: Substring searches are discovery aids only. Plain words such as mode in backend or delivery-mode APIs, duplicate internal references, docs, tests, and fixtures do not become semantic occurrence rows.
payload.source_evidence_rule: Source markers and blob digests are direct occurrence evidence. Every carrier, observability, and authority interpretation is separately labelled by assessment_basis and cannot upgrade source maturity.
